title: License
description: A license or rights statement with a readable label and an optional canonical URL. Omit id when no public license document is available, for example for proprietary or all-rights-reserved content.

id.description: The URL of the license document or license terms. Omit when no public license document exists.

identifier.description: A readable license label or identifier, such as CC BY 4.0, CC0 1.0 Universal, or Proprietary.
